resources.string: Paste the invitation link you got by WhatsApp or email. It only works once; after that the family tree opens here directly. For the very first setup, use the address of your Google web app.
Tip: in WhatsApp, long-press the link, then choose «Share» and «Stammbaum».
Invitation link or web app address
This is not a family tree link. Copy the whole invitation link from WhatsApp or the email.
There is no family tree link in this text.
No connection. Check the internet and try again.
No app found that can open this link.
Without notifications there are no birthday reminders. You can allow them in the app settings.
The last backup of the family tree is %1$d days old. Tap here to make a new one.
There is no backup of the family tree yet. Tap here to make one.

Today is the anniversary of %1$s\'s death.
Without microphone permission the app cannot record voice messages.
Reminders of birthdays from the family tree
Tap to open the card in the family tree.
Notifications are turned off for this app. Without them there are no reminders.
No connection. Using the data loaded last.
All details and photos are end-to-end encrypted. Google only stores unreadable data. Decryption happens here on the phone. The app reminds you of birthdays even when it is closed.
When opening, and after one minute in the background, the app asks for your fingerprint, face or PIN.
There is no screen lock set up on this phone. Set up a PIN or fingerprint in the Android settings so the app lock works.
The next birthdays and family gatherings
Open the app once, then the next birthdays appear here.

New version of the family tree app (%1$s)
Tap to download. Then open the file and confirm the update. Your access and settings stay as they are.

Prek këtu me e shkarku. Pastaj hape skedarin dhe konfirmo përditësimin. Qasja dhe cilësimet e tua mbesin.
